subject: general
question: Which level of classification of organisms comes between 'Family' and 'Species'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Genus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biologists, **such as **Ernst Haeckel**, **Robert Whittaker**, and **Carl **Woese **endeavored to divide all living **species **into broad divisions **called **kingdoms**.
 
• By **naming the sub-groups **at several **levels—kingdom, phylum or division, class, order, family, genus, and species**—further classification is **accomplished**.
 
• The **Taxonomic hierarchy **is another **name for this**.
 
• The **practice of classifying distinct creatures **into **progressively higher biological categories**, either in a **decreasing **or **an increasing order**, from **kingdoms **to **species and vice versa**, is known as **a taxonomic hierarchy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kingdom:-** The highest level of classification is a kingdom. The classification of living things is done into five kingdoms: Animalia, Plantae, Fungi, Protista, and Monera.
 
• **Phylum:- **A phylum is a group of creatures that are distinguished from one another by a common set of traits. The term "division" has been employed in place of "phylum" in the study of plants, prior to the introduction of phyla.
 
• **Class:- **classes were the taxonomic hierarchy's most broad rank. Kingdom The game Animalia has 108 classes. Order is made up of one or more families that are similar to one another.
 
• **Family:- **The term "family" refers to a group of genera with certain commonalities.
 
• **Genus:-** A genus is made up of a number of related species. GA group of creatures that are similar in size, form, and reproductive characteristics is referred to as a species. There are about 8.7 million different species on earth.
